int_name: N BROAD ST & W PIKE ST

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks, but the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes create significant exposure for pedestrians. The presence of a 'Left Turn Yield on Green' sign indicates a high potential for vehicle-pedestrian conflicts during signal phases.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicular traffic while crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection in the foreground.

hazards.name: Left Turn Conflict
hazards.description: Vehicles turning left on a green signal may fail to yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Indicated by the 'Left Turn Yield on Green' sign on the overhead mast arm.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner can block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the curb.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Implement a signal timing change to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection with mixed-use buildings and basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps. However, the environment is compromised by faded crosswalk markings, poor pavement quality, and parked vehicles that likely obstruct sightlines for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street on the right side of the frame.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner may block the line of sight between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on the right side of the street.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and uneven, which can present a trip hazard for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The image shows a wide one-way urban street with residential row houses and a marked zebra crosswalk. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the multi-lane crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands increase exposure for people walking.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross three travel lanes and two parking lanes without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
